protocol.formula: key[3*o+c] = ALPHABET[3*perm8[o]+perm3[c]]; SAME perm3 for every direction
protocol.reading: 87 unchanged glyphs, left to right; ignore dots/row breaks as commands
protocol.score: S = mean conditional log 4gram + 0.5 * Viterbi word segmentation / length; unchanged v5 score
protocol.search: Exhaustive: compute full char and word scores for EVERY key, no early rejection
protocol.secondary: Choose key using first 43 glyphs only by same S; evaluate suffix 44 with that key, no suffix refinement; fixed before scores
protocol.tie: First key in lexicographic perm8, then perm3 order selected by numpy.argmax; comparisons allow 1e-10
protocol.controls: 39 independently generated global directed-bigram-preserving controls for each published transcription, with fixed first/last glyph; each gets full search. Do not select best transcription.
protocol.positives: 12 new published Elgar letter openings, known random keys; first87 ASCII letters after salutation, j->i,v->u; two old regression texts separate
protocol.interpretation: Language score is heuristic, no probability of plaintext. Exploratory family chosen after nine rounds; no global multiple-search correction.

dictionary.normalisation: ASCII lower; j->i and v->u; merge counts; unchanged segmentation penalties
